body: Missed one (would cause a regression in the functionality).
Now both `dof_blur_far_enabled` and `dof_blur_near_enabled` are missing `PROPERTY_HINT_GROUP_ENABLE`, but the previously overridden `_validate_property` method is still removed.

Uh right.
PROPERTY_HINT_GROUP_ENABLE does not apply here, it only supports one enable per group.

EDIT:
Restored `_validate_property()` and did a small cleanup.

Those cases could probably be made into subgroups with the `PROPERTY_HINT_GROUP_ENABLE` bool (it should work with subgroups), but that would change the organization and I think is the first case of this. If that format doesn't look right then that's good to know
